proposed_core_edits.name: spectral_cutoff
proposed_core_edits.reason: The uniform Fourier bias and second-moment balance is attained without a logarithmic undersmoothing factor.

proposed_core_edits.name: law_radius
proposed_core_edits.reason: Balancing Fourier bias with stochastic fluctuation gives the log-free simultaneous environment-law radius.

This propagates the corrected log-free law radius to the explicit primary specialization, records the assumptions used to establish positivity of the transfer exponent, and replaces stale quotient-loss terminology by symmetric two-law aligned discrepancy terminology.

proposed.justification: A computable estimator turns the population frontier into a usable finite-sample guarantee for the same symmetric two-law aligned discrepancy, without numerical differentiation at critical points.
proposed.gap: Acartürk et al. give finite-sample recovery for linear mixers, and Lyu--Fu control a derivative diagnostic for nonlinear ICA; neither handles bounded nonlinear causal decoders or the symmetric aligned representation discrepancy.
proposed.consumer: Implementations on periodic latent coordinates obtain a certified stopping rule and representation error radius from environment samples.
